text:
sam: Heads up — config-only deploy scheduled at 14:00 PT. Reduce per-tenant concurrency_floor 5 -> 3 and bump tiny_batch.max_tokens 128 -> 160 for short prompts. Will canary 5% for 20m.

deploy-bot: CI passed. PR https://github.com/redwood/inference/PR/4821. Scheduled: 2026-03-21T21:00Z. Canary: 5% for 20m. Config commit: 9f3a2b.

lina: Are we pinning routing to model-1.9 for this canary? Last time dynamic routing stressed kvcache.

sam: Yes — pin to model-1.9 for the canary stage, keep dynamic after validation. kvcache.ttl stays 600s.

kevin: I'll own monitoring/rollback. Making a small dashboard; alert `tinybatch_tail_99_9` for p99 tail and kvcache hitrate.

mia: If canary error rate >5% or p99 increases >200ms we rollback. What's the rollback command?

deploy-bot: Rollback command: `/deploy rollback --target=config --commit=previous` (or `9f3a2b` to revert to previous commit).

sam: I'll run `/deploy apply --canary=5 --duration=20m --pin=model-1.9` at T-0 + 10m to let CI and infra checks finish.

oncall-sre: I'll watch host mem and cpu. If mem usage >70% on the canary pool we abort and rollback.

sam: Reminder — config-only but batching changes can affect tail latency; watch qps per-host and kvcache miss rate.

deploy-bot: Canary started: 5% traffic -> model-1.9 (config v20260321_1400). Observability tag: `config=canary-20260321-1400`.

kevin: dashboard live: https://metrics.internal/redwood/d/abc123/tinybatch-watch. :eyes:

lina: Can we add a temporary canary traffic cap of 200rps to limit blast radius?

sam: Added `traffic_shaper.canary_cap=200` in the PR. Deploybot will pick it up.

deploy-bot: Applied config to canary cohort. Sampling traces enabled for 1% of requests.

kevin: Seeing p50 +40ms, p99 flat so far. kvcache hitrate steady ~92%.

mia: No user-facing errors in logs. I'll keep a 1h watch and sign off for promotion if stable.

oncall-sre: Gate policy: if errors >3% sustained for 20m or p99 >300ms then rollback immediately.

sam: Promotion plan: 5% -> 25% (30m) -> 50% (30m) -> 100% (gradual). Manual gate at each step.

mia: Release notes draft: "config-only: decreased per-tenant concurrency floor (5→3), increased tiny_batch.max_tokens (128→160) for short prompts; canary traffic cap 200 rps; pinned canary routing to model-1.9."

kevin: :thumbsup:

sam: Will post final release note after full promotion. Thanks everyone — I'll ping when we promote to 25%.
